question: Should OpenClaw resolve this by converging to one recommended memory backend/config surface, adopting the multi-slot memory role architecture, or keeping the current split model with stronger diagnostics and docs?
rationale: The request touches public config, plugin-slot API, memory storage defaults, and upgrade migration behavior, and current main plus the open role-slot PR show multiple plausible product directions.

options.title: Sponsor a canonical memory architecture decision
options.body: Use this issue together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 to choose the durable config and migration path before implementation.

options.title: Keep the current split model
options.body: Close or narrow this only after maintainers explicitly decide that separate backend, search, flush, and plugin-slot controls are intentional and update diagnostics/docs to reduce confusion.

options.title: Define a smaller config consolidation
options.body: Reject the full role-slot direction for now and create a narrower follow-up for a user-facing memory preset or doctor/setup flow that maps onto existing config without changing plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a canonical memory architecture decision
recommendation.body: Use this issue together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 to choose the durable config and migration path before implementation.
